name: ARA4046
title: Invalid overlay layer
summary: An overlay layer is already open, positioned invalidly, or not mounted under the UI root.
html:
An overlay layer is already open, positioned invalidly, or not mounted under the UI root.

#Common causes

  • The same popup opened twice.

#Fixes

  • Close a layer before reopening it; mount overlays under the root.

  • Code: ARA4046

  • Constant: ui::LAYER

  • Reported by: ara-ui
